description: Shared quota across the multi-room office: coffee, report, phone and mail tasks contribute to one pictogram progress board.
Mor conceals a sabotage card and pulls Mavi's workstation plug while Mavi faces his monitor.
A discreet tip-line caller directs Nermin's attention to a coworker's desk and open drawer.
Pembe and Sari call from separate rooms while Turuncu eavesdrops nearby behind a wall.
An accusing finger at the HR table links a nervous colleague to projected text-free CCTV footage.
Five pictogram day columns progress left-to-right into a Friday star and employee-of-month bean trophy.
